entities.summary: The New National Party (NNP), also known as NNP Grenada, Carriacou and Petite Martinique, is a conservative political party in Grenada. It is led by Emmalin Pierre. New National Party is a political party, established in 1984-08-01. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
